summary: Server singleton: Osiris-issued 'enter combat' requests (ls::Variant alternative 0 of esv::script::RequestSystem's requests), each tagged with the request entity. Filled once per frame by esv::script::RequestSystem::ProcessEmitRequests; pushed by Osiris calls such as SetHostileAndEnterCombat / SetCombatGroupAndEnterCombat through RequestSystem::LEGACY_AddRequestChain. Seen.py context: singleton present in the idle level (one sample held an allocated, empty array).

fields.name: RequestEntity
fields.evidence: esv::script::Requester<T> +0: EoCServer.dll+0x4FA900 (variant visitor of ProcessEmitRequests) stores the first qword of the RequestToExecute (the request entity that RequestSystem::ProcessUpdateRequests creates per queued request).

fields.name: Source
fields.evidence: EnterCombatRequest +0. EoCServer.dll+0x12ACE20 (OsirisGameFunctions::SetHostileAndEnterCombat) fills it with its third argument (entity); EoCServer.dll+0x12AA0F0 (SetCombatGroupAndEnterCombat) with the entity whose combat group is set.

fields.name: Target
fields.evidence: EnterCombatRequest +8: fourth argument of SetHostileAndEnterCombat / third (target) argument of SetCombatGroupAndEnterCombat.

fields.name: Requests
fields.evidence: EoCServer.dll+0x4FA900 case 0: appends to the singleton's DynamicArray, assert ls::IndexedStorage<esv::script::Requester<esv::script::EnterCombatRequest>>, stride 0x18 (entity + 16 bytes copied). macOS names ls::DynamicArray<esv::script::Requester<...>>.
